name: fulcrum-lite
description: Answer questions about Amazon MSK (Kafka) clusters, brokers, topics, consumer groups, connectors (MSK Connect and Kafka Connect) and AWS Glue Schema Registry with read-only AWS CLI commands and, optionally, read-only Kafka admin tools: health, replication, consumer lag and members, broker load and disk, connector failures, schema diffs and compatibility checks. No server, no installs.
